title: Heartbeat
description: Says a collector is alive. Body of kind heartbeat. Not evidence.

evidence.description: The kind of evidence the collector pushes.

hash.description: The content hash from the collector's last good run.

healthy.description: False when the collector's last run failed.

last_success.description: When the collector's last good run finished.

every_seconds.description: The heartbeat interval, so a receiver can tell when one is late.

replica.description: Which copy of the app sent it.

sdk.description: The sender and its version, such as witness-go/0.1.0.
